summary: An editable PowerPoint deck that introduces a company, a product, a service or a partnership offer to a customer or partner: a navy cover with the name in large type, who we are (with the customer’s own figures), what we make or sell, how we work, proof the customer supplied (advantages, clients, certificates, one case) and a closing slide with contacts. Every figure, name, price and claim comes from the customer’s message or file; a missing fact shortens the deck, it is never filled. WHEN TO PICK IT: a deck to show on a screen or send to a customer or partner. A priced offer written as a letter or a document to sign is “Tijorat taklifi” (pdf.biz.tijorat_taklifi); an investor pitch (market,
tone: Plain and factual: a company speaks as “biz”, a product is described by its name in the third person. Every fact on a slide is the customer’s; the AI writes only headings and joining words. Detail goes to the speaker notes, 20 to 40 words a slide.
title: model

length.note: The research counted the number as what the facts support; the count is delivered as quoted and a slot the customer gave nothing for is an honest form. 20 is the most, as the research capped it.

review.uz: Xabaringiz qisqa: ko‘p slaydlarda siz to‘ldiradigan bo‘sh joy bo‘ladi.
review.ru: Сообщение короткое: на многих слайдах останутся пустые места для заполнения.
review.en: Your message is short: many slides will keep blanks for you to fill in.

prompt.uz: 📝 Xohlasangiz, qo‘shing (har birini yangi qatordan): mahsulot yoki xizmatlar (har biriga 2–3 fakt), raqamlar (xodimlar, buyurtmalar, mijozlar), mijozlaringiz, narxlar, aloqa (telefon, Telegram, manzil). Slaydlar faqat siz yozgan ma’lumotlarga tayanadi.
prompt.ru: 📝 По желанию добавьте (каждое с новой строки): продукты или услуги (по 2–3 факта), цифры (сотрудники, заказы, клиенты), ваших клиентов, цены, контакты (телефон, Telegram, адрес). Слайды опираются только на ваши данные.
prompt.en: 📝 If you like, add (each on its own line): products or services (2 to 3 facts each), figures (staff, orders, clients), your clients, prices, contacts (phone, Telegram, address). The slides lean only on what you write.

label.uz: Kompaniya yoki mahsulot nomi (qisqa)
label.en: Company or product name (short)

fields.where: Cover heading (up to 6 words, as the customer uses it, without the legal form, never respelled or translated), the footer line when the account has no brand name, and the cover descriptor. The bot’s existing topic check asks when it is missing.

label.uz: To‘liq rasmiy nomi va STIR (tender uchun)
label.ru: Полное юридическое название и ИНН (для тендера)
label.en: Full legal name and tax number (for a tender)

fields.where: One small line at the end of the closing slide, copied as written (form MChJ, AJ or YaTT included); the short name stays on the cover. Never completed from a registry or guessed; a licence number goes into credentials, not here.

label.uz: Nima bilan shug‘ullanasiz yoki mahsulot nima
label.ru: Чем вы занимаетесь или что это за продукт
label.en: What you do, or what the product is

example.uz: Uy va ofis uchun buyurtma mebel ishlab chiqaramiz
example.ru: Делаем мебель на заказ для дома и офиса
example.en: We make made-to-order furniture for homes and offices

fields.where: Cover subtitle line 1 (up to 10 words, the customer’s own words) and the first fact of the about slide. Without it the deck has no subject: the bot asks.

label.uz: Taqdimot turi: kompaniya, mahsulot, xizmat yoki hamkorlik taklifi
label.ru: Вид презентации: компания, продукт, услуга или предложение о сотрудничестве
label.en: Kind: company, product, service or a partnership offer

fields.where: Picks the template (company profile by default; “mahsulot”, “ilova”, “xizmat paketi”, “taklif”, “hamkorlik” give business_mahsulot) and the fixed descriptor on cover line 2. Not asked: read from the words, company when in doubt.

label.uz: Taqdimotni kimga ko‘rsatasiz: mijoz, hamkor, tender, xodimlar
label.ru: Кому покажете презентацию: клиентам, партнёрам, на тендере, сотрудникам
label.en: Who will see the deck: customers, partners, a tender, staff

fields.where: Sets emphasis and register only (a tender deck keeps the legal line and credentials, a customer deck leads with products); never written on a slide. Not the same as target_customers (whom the product serves).

label.uz: Qaysi yildan ishlaysiz
label.en: The year you started

fields.where: About-slide heading. The founding year is what the customer wrote; it is never turned into “12 yil” by arithmetic (the year goes stale). If the customer wrote both a year and a count of years and they disagree, the founding year wins and the count is left out.

label.uz: Raqamlar: xodim, buyurtma, mijoz, filial
label.en: Figures: staff, orders, clients, branches

fields.where: The 2 to 4 figures of the about slide (value = the figure with its sign, label = the noun the customer used; an explanatory line under a figure only if the customer wrote one). With one figure or none the about slide is plain facts.

label.uz: Mahsulot yoki xizmatlar, har biriga 2-3 fakt
label.ru: Продукты или услуги, к каждому 2-3 факта
label.en: Products or services, 2 to 3 facts each

example.uz: oshxona mebeli: o‘lchovdan o‘rnatishgacha, stol usti ro‘yxatdan tanlanadi, o‘rnatishni o‘z ustalarimiz bajaradi
example.ru: кухни: от замера до установки, столешница выбирается из списка, монтаж делают наши мастера
example.en: kitchens: from measuring to installation, the worktop is chosen from a list, our own craftsmen install

fields.where: The products overview (3 to 6 lines, “name: the customer’s phrase”) and one detail slide per product that has at least two facts of its own. A product with one fact stays on the overview. Asked once (extra step) when the supportable count falls 3 or more short of the requested count.

label.uz: Nimasi bilan farq qilasiz: tekshirsa bo‘ladigan faktlar
label.en: What you do differently: facts one can check

example.uz: o‘z ustaxonamiz; usta o‘zi o‘lchaydi; muddat shartnomada yoziladi
example.ru: собственная мастерская; мастер замеряет сам; срок записан в договоре
example.en: our own workshop; the craftsman measures; the deadline is in the contract

fields.where: The advantages slide (3 to 5 lines), each line the customer’s fact in the customer’s words with no benefit or guarantee added. A bare adjective (sifatli, tajribali) is dropped; fewer than three facts means no slide.

label.uz: Buyurtma yoki xizmat qanday bajariladi (3-5 qadam)
label.ru: Как выполняется заказ или услуга (3-5 шагов)
label.en: How an order or service runs (3 to 5 steps)

fields.where: “How we work” (company) or “How it works” / “How to start” (product, offer): the steps as given, labels only unless the customer wrote a few words for a step. Never drafted: invented stages are a claim about the company.

label.uz: Mijoz va hamkorlar (ruxsat bilan), nima qilingani va yili
label.ru: Клиенты и партнёры (с их согласия), что сделано и в каком году
label.en: Clients and partners (with permission), what was done and when

example.ru: Namuna Hotel: мебель для отеля на 40 номеров, 2024
example.en: Namuna Hotel: furniture for a 40-room hotel, 2024

fields.where: The clients slide, names exactly as written, at most 6 on the slide (the rest in the notes and the customer is told). No logos, no “many leading companies”; fewer than three names: no slide.

label.uz: Bitta loyiha: vaziyat, nima qilindi, natija
label.en: One project: situation, solution, result

example.uz: Namuna Hotel 40 ta xona uchun mebel buyurtma qildi, bitta andoza bo‘yicha seriya yasadik, 3 haftada topshirdik
example.ru: Намуна Отель заказал мебель на 40 номеров, сделали серию по одному образцу, сдали за 3 недели
example.en: Namuna Hotel ordered furniture for 40 rooms, we made a series from one template, delivered in 3 weeks

fields.where: The case slide: Vaziyat / Yechim / Natija, one sentence each, in the customer’s words. Needs at least the situation and the result. Never composed from the topic; the notes remind the presenter to ask the client’s permission.

label.uz: Litsenziya, sertifikat, mukofot: nomi, raqami, sanasi
label.ru: Лицензии, сертификаты, награды: название, номер, дата
label.en: Licences, certificates, awards: name, number, date

fields.where: The licences and certificates slide, name, number and date copied as written. A standard, register or licence the customer did not name is never written.

label.uz: Mahsulot qaysi muammoni hal qiladi (2-4 ta)
label.en: The problem the product solves (2 to 4)

example.uz: hisob daftarda yuritiladi, qoldiq noma’lum, kunlik hisobot qo‘lda yig‘iladi
example.ru: учёт ведут в тетради, остатки неизвестны, дневной отчёт собирают вручную
example.en: records are kept in a notebook, stock levels are unknown, the daily report is put together by hand

fields.where: The problem slide of the product template, each pain restating what the customer wrote. When no problem is named the slide is dropped: a problem drafted from the product’s purpose is a market claim.

label.uz: Mijozga foyda: raqam yoki aniq natija
label.ru: Выгода клиенту: цифра или конкретный результат
label.en: The benefit to the customer: a figure or a concrete result

example.uz: kunlik hisobot 5 daqiqada tayyor, 30 kun bepul sinov
example.ru: дневной отчёт готов за 5 минут, 30 дней бесплатного теста
example.en: the daily report is ready in 5 minutes, 30 days free trial

fields.where: The “in numbers” slide (two or more figures) or, in an offer, “Hamkorlikdan foyda” (three stated benefits). Without either the slide does not exist.

label.uz: Mahsulot kimlar uchun (mijoz turlari)
label.en: Whom the product serves (types of customer)

example.uz: oziq-ovqat do‘konlari, kafe, kiyim do‘konlari, dorixonalar
example.ru: продуктовые магазины, кафе, магазины одежды, аптеки
example.en: grocery shops, cafes, clothing shops, pharmacies

fields.where: The “Kimlar uchun” slide (4 to 6 customer types the customer named, or 3 as plain lines). Not the same as shown_to.

label.uz: Narxlar yoki tariflar
label.en: Prices or plans

fields.where: The prices slide (product and offer decks, and company decks when a price list is attached), rows as given with the currency as written. A plan the customer did not name is “Tarif 1 / 2 / 3”; a period (“/ oy”) only if the customer wrote it; no discount, no total, no “arzon”.

label.uz: Hamkorlik shartlari (taklif uchun)
label.en: Terms of cooperation (for an offer)

example.en: 50% upfront, the deadline is in the contract

fields.where: The terms table of a partnership offer, one row per term as given; the slide is dropped without terms.

label.uz: Mahsulotni kim yaratgan (kompaniya nomi)
label.en: Who made the product (company name)

fields.where: Product deck: cover line 3 and a closing line “Yaratuvchi: ...”, so that a partner who receives the file can tell who stands behind it; with two or more facts about the maker, a short “Biz haqimizda” slide. Never taken from a Telegram handle or a domain.

label.uz: Aloqa: telefon, Telegram, Instagram, manzil, sayt, ish vaqti
label.ru: Контакты: телефон, Telegram, Instagram, адрес, сайт, часы работы
label.en: Contacts: phone, Telegram, Instagram, address, website, hours

fields.where: Closing-slide lines, copied as written, labelled. Asked once (skippable) when the first message has no phone, Telegram, Instagram, site or address; if skipped, “Telefon: ________” and “Telegram: ________” stay as ruled blanks and the review screen says so. Nothing is inferred from a handle (a handle is not a booking channel, a site is not an address).

label.uz: Aloqa uchun shaxs: ism va lavozim
label.en: Contact person: name and role

fields.where: One closing line “Aloqa uchun: ...” before the phone; never invented or taken from an example.

label.uz: Katalog, narx ro‘yxati yoki eski taqdimot (PDF, Word, TXT)
label.ru: Каталог, прайс-лист или старая презентация (PDF, Word, TXT)
label.en: A catalogue, price list or old presentation (PDF, Word, TXT)

example.en: the price list attached as a PDF

fields.where: Source of products, prices, figures and clients where the message is silent; the message wins when they disagree on a figure. A file counts toward the supportable count slot by slot.

label.uz: Slayd soni yoki chiqish vaqti
label.en: Slide count or talk length

fields.where: Deck length, a ceiling (10 when absent, 20 at most); minutes are read as minutes plus 2.

parts.write: Heading = the short name as written, without the legal form (44 pt, three lines hold six words; the full legal name goes to the closing slide). Body = lines: what it is, from the customer’s words (up to 10 words); the fixed descriptor: Kompaniya taqdimoti / Презентация компании / Company presentation, Mahsulot taqdimoti or Xizmat taqdimoti / Презентация продукта or услуги / Product or Service presentation, Hamkorlik taklifi / Предложение о сотрудничестве / Partnership offer; in a product deck a third line “Yaratuvchi: <maker>” when the customer named one. No year, no slogan the customer did not write. NO photo by default (image_query empty): the cover stands without one and the right part carries the diagonal pattern; a photo only when the customer asks, a concrete thing in 2 to 4 English words, and the review screen says “rasm — stok, o‘zingizniki bilan almashtiring”. The account logo, when there is one, sits on a white plate in a zone the cover reserves.

With two to four figures: stats, each a value (the figure with at most one short sign: +, %, a unit of up to 4 letters) and a label of up to 3 words that is the noun the customer used (xodim, buyurtma, shahar); a line under a figure ONLY if the customer wrote one (the earlier “context under every figure” rule is removed: it forced invented lines). The founding year goes into the heading, never into a figure computed from it. With one figure or none: bullets.classic, the facts the customer gave (what is made, where, since when), one line each; a mission or vision only if the customer wrote it. Notes: how to say it in two sentences, no new fact.

With two to four figures: stats, each a value (the figure with at most one short sign: +, %, a unit of up to 4 letters) and a label of up to 3 words that is the noun the customer used (xodim, buyurtma, shahar); a line under a figure ONLY if the customer wrote one (the earlier “context under every figure” rule is removed: it forced invented lines). The founding year goes into the heading, never into a figure computed from it. With one figure or none: bullets.classic, the facts the customer gave (what is made, where, since when), one line each; a mission or vision only if the customer wrote it. Notes: how to say it in two sentences, no new fact.

2 to 4 pains the customer named, each a label of up to 4 words restating their words, no text line. With no problem named: the honest form (heading and ruled lines), never a draft from the product’s purpose, which would be a market claim.
One sentence of at most 14 words (120 characters) that is the customer’s own description: what it does and for whom; the heading is the small label above it.

Heading, in the deck’s language: Mahsulotlarimiz | Xizmatlarimiz | Nima taklif qilamiz / Наша продукция | Наши услуги | Что мы предлагаем / Our products | Our services | What we offer. 3 to 6 lines, each “name: the customer’s own phrase” of at most 10 words, or the name alone when the customer gave none (a name with no phrase is honest, a drafted phrase is not); never a price, duration, guarantee, material or brand unless given. With one or two items the overview lists just those. The heading noun follows what the customer sells (products, services, both).

1 to 4 lines, only the lines the customer’s words support: what it is, what is included, for whom, how it is finished or delivered; a line the customer did not support is LEFT OUT, never replaced by a plausible one. A product the customer gave no lines for is the honest form (heading and ruled lines). Each line at most 14 words. A neutral one-line definition of a named thing may be drafted ONLY for a plain good (a wardrobe, a lamp), never for a medical, legal, financial, educational-licence or safety service (the clinic example: “Implantatsiya” stays a bare name), is marked “[Qoralama: ...]” in the notes, is listed on the review screen and never counts toward the supportable count. No photo by default: stock photos of “kitchens” or “workshop” present someone else’s work as the company’s; the slide is text. Two or three product slides in a row are allowed.

Heading, in the deck’s language: Imkoniyatlar | (taklif:) Biz taklif qilamiz / Возможности | (предложение:) Что мы предлагаем / Features | (offer:) What we offer. 2 to 6 lines, each a function or an offer the customer named, at most 10 words, nothing added to make it look complete. A feature the customer did not name is never written.

3 to 5 steps in the customer’s order: a label of up to 3 words and, only if the customer wrote them, up to 8 more words after a colon. The numerals are right here because the order matters. The count in the heading is the number of steps the customer gave. Without steps from the customer: the honest form (heading and ruled lines).

Heading, in the deck’s language: Qanday ishlaydi | (taklif:) Qanday boshlaymiz / Как это работает | (предложение:) Как начать / How it works | (offer:) How to start. 3 to 5 steps in the customer’s order, at most 8 words each; in an offer the steps are the customer’s own path to a first order.

3 to 5 lines, each the customer’s fact in the customer’s own words, at most 10 words, with nothing appended: “Usta o‘zi o‘lchaydi”, not “...: o‘lcham xatosi bo‘lmaydi” (a benefit or a guarantee the customer did not state is a claim). Unnumbered: the advantages are not a ranking. A line with no fact is left out; with no facts at all, the honest form (heading and ruled lines). No superlatives.
3 to 5 customer types the customer named (field target_customers), at most 6 words each, no reason added. Fewer than three: only those named; none: the honest form (heading and ruled lines).

Heading, in the deck’s language: <Nomi> raqamlarda | (taklif:) Hamkorlikdan foyda / <Название> в цифрах | (предложение:) Что вы получите / <Name> in numbers | (offer:) What you gain. Figures only as the customer gave them (value = figure with one short sign, the unit and the noun in the label; no line under it). Without two figures: the benefits the customer stated, one line each (“Komissiya 8%”), or with none, the honest form (heading and ruled lines). “Sizga nima foyda” is not used (clipped); “Hamkorlikdan foyda” or “Sizga nima beramiz” are.
columns = Nomi | Raqami | Sana (Название | Номер | Дата; Name | Number | Date), 1 to 6 rows copied as written. Name, number and date are never completed, converted or guessed.

Heading, in the deck’s language: Narxlar | (taklif:) Hamkorlik shartlari / Цены | (предложение:) Условия сотрудничества / Prices | (offer:) Terms of cooperation. Columns Tarif | Narx (Тариф | Цена; Plan | Price) or Mahsulot | Narx, with a third column “Nimalar kiradi” ONLY when the customer listed what each plan includes; or, in an offer, Shart | Ta’rif (Условие | Описание; Term | Description). 2 to 6 rows as given; unnamed plans are “Tarif 1 / 2 / 3” (Тариф 1 / 2 / 3, Plan 1 / 2 / 3); the currency as written and a period (“/ oy”) only if written; a range as a range; no total, no discount, no “arzon”.

Heading, in the deck’s language: Mijozlarimiz | Mijozlar va hamkorlar / Наши клиенты | Клиенты и партнёры / Our clients | Clients and partners. Names exactly as given. With what was made and a year: a table with the columns Mijoz | <middle header> | Yil, up to 6 rows. The middle header follows the business and is chosen from this fixed list, never “Nimani tayyorladik” for everyone: Nima qildik / Что сделали / What we did (makes or builds things for clients), Loyiha / Проект / Project (agency, IT, consulting, design), Xizmat / Услуга / Service (clinic, salon, school, any service to people). Names only: 3 to 5 as bullets.card_stack, 6 as bullets.classic (unnumbered: a number beside a client reads as a rank). At most 6 names on the slide; more go to the notes and the customer is told. A client the customer left unnamed stays anonymous (“mehmonxona”). No logos, no “ko‘plab yirik kompaniyalar”. The notes say “ruxsat so‘rang”. No names: the honest form (heading and ruled lines).

Heading, in the deck’s language: Keys | Loyiha: <natija, raqami bilan> / Кейс | Проект: <результат с цифрой> / Case | Project: <the result with its figure>. Three lines “Vaziyat: ...”, “Yechim: ...”, “Natija: ...” (Ситуация / Решение / Результат; Situation / Solution / Result), each at most 14 words in the customer’s words; the heading states the result with the customer’s own figure and stays within 42 characters. The prefix is “Keys” by default and “Loyiha” when the work was not for a paying client or the customer calls it a project (a clinic’s patients, an app’s users). A client the customer did not name is described by the customer’s own word (“mehmonxona”) in the Vaziyat line. Needs the situation and the result; without them, the honest form (heading and ruled lines). A second case from 14 slides.

The heading is fixed. Lines, each labelled in the deck’s language, in this order of importance: Telefon and Telegram (on one line separated by “ · ” when both are given and there are more than four lines); Instagram and site (one line); Aloqa uchun: <person>; Manzil; the legal line (field legal_name, as written; in a product deck “Yaratuvchi: <maker>” before it); the fixed invitation of one line, which promises nothing: “Savollar uchun yozing yoki qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.” / «По вопросам пишите или звоните.» / “Write or call us with any question.” (the first line dropped when there are more than five lines). A line the customer did not give is left out, except phone and Telegram, which stay as “Telefon: ________” and “Telegram: ________” (at most those two ruled blanks; never an address blank); with no contacts at all: heading, invitation and the two blanks. Every label is written, none is left bare (a website is “Sayt: ...” when it stands alone). No notes. In an offer the heading may be “Hamkorlik uchun yozing”.

rules.text: Every figure, name, date, place, price, unit, client, certificate, term and claim restates the message or an attached file. Never invent a founding year, headcount, number of orders, clients or branches, a rating, award, licence, certificate, standard, client or partner name, price, discount, guarantee, delivery time, team member, testimonial, result or saving.

No puffery: never “eng yaxshi”, “yetakchi”, “№1”, “ishonchli”, “kafolatlangan”, “noyob”, “individual yondashuv” or their Russian and English equivalents unless the customer wrote that claim. An advantage is the customer’s fact in the customer’s words; a bare adjective is dropped.

Numbers exactly as written, with unit and period; thousands with a space, decimal comma, “so‘m” (сум) after the figure; never rounded, summed, converted or computed (years in business are not derived from a founding year).

Headings at most 42 characters and 6 words, on one line; a line at most 14 words; 10 to 45 words a slide. This overrides the global guide of about 111 words a slide. Never a rhetorical question, emoji or exclamation mark. The reader is addressed only on the closing slide, in the polite “siz” form.

Clients and partners: only the names the customer gave, at most 6, with what was made and the year only as given. Credentials: name, number and date as written. A case is Vaziyat, Yechim, Natija, one sentence each, only from the customer’s account. Prices and terms: rows as given, currency as written, no total, discount or comparison.

Contacts on the closing slide only as given; a phone or Telegram line the customer did not give is a ruled blank “________” to fill in. The legal name and tax number, when given, are one small line on the closing slide.
A slide the customer gave nothing for is an honest form: its heading and lines ending in a ruled blank, the notes saying what to write; never a generic or plausible slide.

Layout by the content: 2 to 4 figures, stats; named things, bullets; an ordered path, numbered bullets; rows of facts, a table of at most 3 columns and 6 rows; pains, cards; one sentence, statement. No photo on a product, service or case slide; a cover photo only when asked, never a person or a logo.
Language follows the customer’s; product names, brands and handles stay as written. Uzbek is Latin only, o‘ and g‘ with ‘ and the tutuq belgisi with ’.

prompt.uz:
🏢 Kompaniya yoki mahsulot taqdimoti. Bitta xabarda yozing: nomi, nima bilan shug‘ullanishingiz, taqdimotni kimga ko‘rsatasiz (mijoz, hamkor, tender) va necha slayd (aytmasangiz, 10 ta).
Raqamlar, xizmatlar (har biriga 2-3 fakt), mijozlar, narxlar va aloqa ma’lumotlarini ham yozing: slaydlar faqat shularga tayanadi, o‘zimizdan hech narsa to‘qib chiqarmaymiz. Ma’lumot berilmagan slaydlarda to‘ldirish uchun bo‘sh joy qoladi.
📎 Katalog, narx ro‘yxati yoki eski taqdimotni PDF, Word yoki TXT qilib qo‘shing.
prompt.ru:
🏢 Презентация компании или продукта. Напишите одним сообщением: название, чем вы занимаетесь, кому покажете презентацию (клиентам, партнёрам, на тендере) и сколько слайдов (если не указать, будет 10).
Добавьте цифры, услуги (по 2-3 факта на каждую), клиентов, цены и контакты: слайды опираются только на них, мы ничего не выдумываем. Где данных нет, на слайдах останутся пустые места для заполнения.
📎 Каталог, прайс-лист или старую презентацию пришлите файлом PDF, Word или TXT.
prompt.en:
🏢 A company or product presentation. Say it in one message: the name, what you do, who will see the deck (customers, partners, a tender) and how many slides (10 if you do not say).
Add your figures, services (2 to 3 facts each), clients, prices and contacts: the slides lean only on them, and we make nothing up. Where you give no details, the slides keep blanks for you to fill in.
📎 Add a catalogue, a price list or an old presentation as a PDF, Word or TXT file.

examples.en: I need a 10-slide presentation of the Namuna Furniture company to show new customers. We make made-to-order furniture for homes and offices in Tashkent, since 2013. 28 staff, 340+ orders, 3 cities. Products: kitchens, office furniture, wardrobes. Kitchens from measuring to installation: cabinets and a bar counter, the worktop and fittings are chosen from a list, our own craftsmen install. Office furniture with a layout plan: desks and shelves, reception furniture, the client approves the plan. How we work: measuring, design, production, installation. Advantages: our own workshop, the craftsman measures, the deadline is in the contract. Clients: Namuna Hotel, Namuna Clinic, Namuna School. Case: Namuna Hotel ordered furniture for 40 rooms, we made a series from one template, delivered in 3 weeks. Phone: +998 00 000 00 00, Telegram: @namuna_mebel.

examples.en: A presentation of the Namuna Kassa app, 8 slides, to show to shop owners. The app was made by Namuna Soft. Namuna Kassa is a sales and stock records app for small shops. Problem: records are kept in a notebook, stock levels are unknown, the daily report is put together by hand. Features: printing receipts, stock levels, a daily report. How it works: you register, enter your products, start selling. Plans: 99,000, 199,000 and 349,000 so‘m. The daily report is ready in 5 minutes, 30 days free trial. Telegram: @namuna_kassa.
